entries.title: Proverbs 2:1
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Hide - Lay them up in thy heart with care, as men do their choicest treasures.

entries.title: Proverbs 2:3
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Criest - To God, the only giver of it.

entries.title: Proverbs 2:4
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Seek her - With unwearied diligence and earnest desire and patient expectation.

entries.title: Proverbs 2:8
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Path of judgment - Righteous paths, judgment being here put for righteousness. And keeping of paths may be put for keeping them in their paths.

entries.title: Proverbs 2:9
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Then - When God in answer to thy desires hath given thee wisdom. Equity - All the parts of thy duty to man, as well as the fear of God.

entries.title: Proverbs 2:15
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Crooked - Who swerve from the straight way of God's law, and have windings and turnings, to escape conviction.

entries.title: Proverbs 2:16
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Strange woman - From the adulteress or whore.

entries.title: Proverbs 2:17
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Forsaketh - Her husband whom she took to be her guide and governor, in her youth. The covenant - The marriage covenant: so called because God is the author of that mutual obligation: and because God is called to be the witness and judge of that solemn promise and covenant.

entries.title: Proverbs 2:18
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: For - Conversation with her (which was most usual in her own house) is the certain way to death, which it brings many ways, and undoubtedly, without repentance, to God's wrath and the second death.

entries.title: Proverbs 2:20
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: That - This depends upon ver. 11, and is mentioned as another happy fruit of wisdom.
